summary: The conditional theorem and proof are correct. The complement density gives the exact centroid first-moment identity and transfers the common chart to the fiber centroids with residual rank at most three. Exact synchronized retention includes every internal endpoint in each retained endpoint set and double-counts each positive whole label exactly twice. In the equality case, deleting a minimum retained endpoint loses at most one sixth of the mass because the accepted endpoint count is at least six. The strict constants are correct, and accepted fact d01de728d8b5e33c equation (38) applies to each constructed nonempty subset with exactly the factor 4 gamma_d needed to contradict R_sel(C) < Q/100.
